model_annotation: This plot illustrates the performance of four model variants across a range of values on a logarithmic x-axis. The x-axis is labeled with powers of 2, ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸, displayed on a logarithmic (base-2) scale. The y-axis appears to represent a numeric metric on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 4 to 9, with gridlines at integer intervals. Four lines are shown in the plot. The first, labeled "Llama-3B," is depicted as a solid blue line with filled circle markers; it starts at approximately 4.2 at x = 2⁰ and rises steadily, reaching roughly 8.8 at x = 2⁸. The second, labeled "Llama-3B + FT," is shown as a dashed green line with square markers; it follows a very similar trajectory to Llama-3B, starting near 4.2 at x = 2⁰ and reaching approximately 8.7 at x = 2⁸, with the two lines largely overlapping throughout. The third, labeled "Llama-1B," is a solid light blue line with open circle markers; it begins at approximately 4.0 at x = 2⁰ and increases to around 8.5 at x = 2⁸, generally tracking slightly below the 3B variants. The fourth, labeled "Llama-1B + FT," is displayed as a dashed light green line with triangle markers; it starts near 4.0 at x = 2⁰ and rises to approximately 8.5 at x = 2⁸, closely following the Llama-1B line. All four lines exhibit a monotonically increasing trend with a concave shape, showing steeper gains at lower x-values and a gradual flattening toward the higher end of the x-axis.
